extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, journalists, and the general public seeking country-level reference data on energy infrastructure and political parties (circa 2004–2005)
extracted.subtask_description: A country-by-country reference listing giving lengths of oil/gas/petroleum pipelines and enumerations of political parties and leaders, with dates indicating the data's vintage (2003–2005). Useful as a factual reference rather than guidance or evaluative criteria.
